about: - The dungeon manager you’ve been waiting for: Dungeons 3 is the biggest, best, and evil-est dungeon sim yet, topped off with a fully reworked overworld RTS mode.
- Under new management: Command the united forces of evil under the guidance of new character Thalya and lead them to victory.

- Size does matter: Extensive single player campaign with 20 missions and more than 20 hours of playtime, randomly generated levels, a brand new co-op mode for two players, more rooms, and more unique abilities.
Remote Play requires PS Vita system and sufficiently robust Wi-Fi connection.
PS4 game can be controlled via PS Vita
summary: Remote Play requires PS Vita system and sufficiently robust Wi-Fi connection.
